exact_failure_inventory.detail: JUnit XML and exact failure inventory agree: 2,105 passed, 2 failed out of 2,107.

environment_qualification.detail: Host Windows NTFS environment characterized; WSL2/Docker limitations documented without unauthorized provisioning.

steady_state_performance.detail: All 5 isolated repetitions passed (< 50 ms mean, < 150 ms P95); passed 8/8 in full continuous suite.

file_append_stress.detail: 10,000 sequential events require 30,000 physical fsyncs and 20,000 atomic replacements; Windows NTFS journal commit barrier bounds P95 latency to ~11-15 ms vs 5.0 ms threshold. Durability preserved.

durability_validation.detail: Zero lost records, zero torn reads, transactional state advancement, and crash recovery all 100% verified.

sprint_11_23_regression.detail: 422/422 tests passing in prospective macro events family.

security_invariants.detail: All 12 security invariants verified; RFC 8032 Ed25519 active; offline guards intact.

technical_decision_rationale: Under the project's strict fail-closed governance criteria, Technical GO requires all conditions to pass, including all mandatory performance thresholds. Because the host Windows NTFS physical drive enforces journal metadata commit latencies that bound file-append P95 latency to ~11-15 ms vs the 5.0 ms micro-benchmark requirement, and CBE rules strictly prohibit weakening os.fsync durability or manufacturing results, this benchmark is legitimately classified as BLOCKED and the technical gate must remain TECHNICAL_NO_GO until tested on a designated low-latency Linux storage tier or container.
